verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is a public GitHub repository for the client SDK (tavily-ai/tavily-python), so some client-side source is readable. Nothing in the pack shows the license for that repo, and nothing indicates the core search, extract, crawl and research service is open source. missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g., MIT/Apache) on any repository, published source for the core Tavily service rather than just the SDK client, and independent corroboration of license terms.
